verdict.rationale: Abacum's own AI Modeler lets users build financial models "in plain language" with "no formulas needed", and its in-model AI produces answers. That is a first-party natural-language interface, but the evidence covers only model building and Q&A, not broader operation of the product by command. The evidence is vendor marketing only. Missing for 10: documentation of natural-language commands beyond model building (e.g., running scenarios, reports, or workspace actions by command), depth and limits of the AI Modeler, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Meet AI Modeler: financial models in plain language. No formulas needed.
Abacum runs AI inside your model, so every answer is consistent, reusable, and grounded in how your business actually works.
